# --attest --attest-signing-key emits a BOM-level JSF signature (signers/ES256)

exec vens generate --llm=mock --attest --attest-signing-key=attest.key --attest-signing-key-id=vens-test-key --llm-seed=7 --config-file=config.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555 report.json output.cdx.json
stderr 'Processing vulnerabilities'
stderr 'Attestation written'

exists output.cdx.json
exists output.attestation.cdx.json

json-contains output.attestation.cdx.json '"signature"'
json-contains output.attestation.cdx.json '"signers"'
json-contains output.attestation.cdx.json '"algorithm": "ES256"'
json-contains output.attestation.cdx.json '"keyId": "vens-test-key"'
json-contains output.attestation.cdx.json '"kty": "EC"'
json-contains output.attestation.cdx.json '"crv": "P-256"'
json-contains output.attestation.cdx.json '"value"'

# evidence still present alongside the signature
json-contains output.attestation.cdx.json '"name": "prompt_hash"'
json-contains output.attestation.cdx.json '"claims"'
